caption:
Everyone tells you to buy more hangers. That's not why your rod is jammed.

Standard hangers are thick at the shoulder, so even a tidy count of them eats up rod inches, lets shirts slide into a pile, and leaves no clear gap between outfits.

The Amazon Basics Slim Velvet Non-Slip Space Saving Suit Clothes Hangers, a 100-pack rated 4.8 stars across 231,174 reviews, use a thin non-slip build so each piece keeps its own slot instead of sliding into the next.

At $39.99 for 100, it's a width fix, not a storage fix, and it's the difference between a jammed rod and one with breathing room.
